title: Explain the Plugin alerts count on Admin overview
summary: The Plugin alerts number on the Admin overview now counts only problems that need action, and links to a list explaining each one.
changes: Plugin alerts now counts only plugins that are turned off or missing from the release.
Clicking the number opens a list with the reason for each alert and a link to fix it in Plugins.
Plugins that are not made for a module, or that are in use, are listed separately as notes for information.
version_rationale: Patch: fixes a misleading count on the Admin overview, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for a healthy install, a turned-off plugin, reasons and fix links.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.48.3 Beta, issue #474 under epic #470, pull request #601.
